press_references.value: Seer Redefining Deep Unbiased Proteomics with Launch of New Proteograph Workflow at ASMS 2025, Enabling Previously Unattainable Scale and Efficiency

product_launches.description: Seer, Inc. has launched its new Proteograph Product Suite, including the Proteograph ONE Assay and SP200 Automation Instrument, at the ASMS 2025 conference. This new workflow significantly increases the scalability, throughput, and affordability of deep, unbiased proteomic analysis, enabling population-scale studies and reducing per-sample costs by about 60% compared to the previous version. The product will be commercially available starting June 1, 2025.

overview_description.description: Seer is a developer of a life sciences and health data platform intended to facilitate early, pre-symptomatic detection of chronic life-threatening diseases. The company's platform captures and translates molecular insights from the proteome with improved accuracy and speed, enabling healthcare professionals to detect cancer and neurological diseases, drive earlier treatment and improve patient outcomes.

about_short_description.short_description: Seer is a biotechnology company that offers tools and solutions related to the field of proteomics.

product.name: Proteograph Product Suite
product.description: A proteomics platform that enables comprehensive analysis of proteins and peptides to support biological research and biomarker discovery.

product.name: Proteograph ONE Assay Kit
product.description: An assay kit for preparing biological samples to analyze proteins and peptides using the Proteograph platform.

product.name: Proteograph DIRECT Assay Kit
product.description: An assay kit that provides protocols and materials for direct sample preparation and peptide analysis in proteomics workflows.

product.name: Proteograph Analysis Suite
product.description: Software suite for analyzing proteomics data, enabling investigation of complex biology and biomarker discovery.

product.name: SP200 Automation Instrument
product.description: An automated instrument designed to support proteomics workflows by automating sample processing steps.

product.name: Proteograph Plus Service Plan
product.description: A service plan offering maintenance and support for the SP200 Automation Instrument to ensure operational continuity.
